Module.Title: PF2E Affliction Forge: Occult Horrors
Module.LibraryDescription: Original occult afflictions themed around dreams, shadows, parasites, and mutation with semantic Creature Forge tags.
Module.SyncFailed: Occult Horrors could not synchronize its library. See console.

whisper-itch.Name: Whisper Itch
whisper-itch.Description: A nearly inaudible murmur crawls beneath the skin, making every quiet moment unbearable.

candle-moth-dust.Name: Candle-Moth Dust
candle-moth-dust.Description: Pale dust from occult-touched moths settles on eyes and thoughts, provoking brief waking dreams.

hollow-sleep-fever.Name: Hollow-Sleep Fever
hollow-sleep-fever.Description: The victim sleeps, but the mind never rests; each dream leaves an empty place behind.

mirror-leech-mark.Name: Mirror-Leech Mark
mirror-leech-mark.Description: A cold blemish in the reflection feeds on courage and certainty even when the skin shows nothing.

nightglass-spores.Name: Nightglass Spores
nightglass-spores.Description: Black-glimmering spores grow in the lungs and cast dark splinters across perception.

pale-whisper-venom.Name: Pale Whisper Venom
pale-whisper-venom.Description: The venom whispers in voices that do not come from the room until pain and thought blur together.

echo-worm-infestation.Name: Echo-Worm Infestation
echo-worm-infestation.Description: Threadlike parasites nest near the ears and repeat thoughts in an alien voice.

black-candle-curse.Name: Black Candle Curse
black-candle-curse.Description: A soot-dark curse extinguishes light at the edges of vision and draws grave-cold into the body.

dream-eater-pollen.Name: Dream-Eater Pollen
dream-eater-pollen.Description: Silvery pollen lures the mind into half-remembered dreams and feeds at the edge of waking.

shadow-lace.Name: Shadow Lace
shadow-lace.Description: Fine strands of shadow wind around joints and thoughts, pulling the victim subtly out of rhythm.

glass-eye-fever.Name: Glass-Eye Fever
glass-eye-fever.Description: The eyes become mirror-smooth and reveal things lurking behind the visible world.

sable-spider-venom.Name: Sable Spider Venom
sable-spider-venom.Description: The dark venom of great night spiders numbs the muscles while shadows seem to crawl across the skin.

false-memory-blight.Name: False-Memory Blight
false-memory-blight.Description: The curse plants memories that feel truer than truth and fray concentration.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 2d6 mental damage and stupefied 1; concentrate actions require a DC 5 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 3d6 mental damage and stupefied 2; concentrate actions require a DC 6 flat check.

moon-mouth-parasite.Name: Moon-Mouth Parasite
moon-mouth-parasite.Description: A pale parasite opens tiny ring-shaped wounds during sleep and feeds on blood and vitality.

name-thief-mark.Name: Name-Thief Mark
name-thief-mark.Description: The curse pulls the victim’s own name from their throat; words become difficult and identity starts to blur.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 2d6 mental damage and stupefied 1; speaking is blocked.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 3d6 mental damage and stupefied 2; speaking is blocked.

whispering-mycelium.Name: Whispering Mycelium
whispering-mycelium.Description: The mycelium grows in damp caves, whispering the same impossible sentence through every inhaled spore.

astral-leech-fever.Name: Astral Leech Fever
astral-leech-fever.Description: Invisible leeches cling to the soul, draining warmth, memories, and vitality at once.

veil-wasp-venom.Name: Veil-Wasp Venom
veil-wasp-venom.Description: A veil wasp’s sting knocks consciousness out of the body for heartbeats at a time.

doppelshade-curse.Name: Doppelshade Curse
doppelshade-curse.Description: A second shadow appears, moves a heartbeat late, and eventually begins to interfere with the victim’s motions.

sleepwalker-rot.Name: Sleepwalker Rot
sleepwalker-rot.Description: The victim wakes with dirt on their feet and wounds they cannot remember receiving.

thoughtmold-bloom.Name: Thoughtmold Bloom
thoughtmold-bloom.Description: An invisible mold infects memories rather than flesh, causing thoughts to grow in alien patterns.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 4d6 mental damage and stupefied 2; concentrate actions require a DC 5 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 5d6 mental damage, stupefied 2, and confused; concentrate actions require a DC 7 flat check.

red-dream-venom.Name: Red-Dream Venom
red-dream-venom.Description: The red venom turns pain into vivid dream fragments until the victim cannot distinguish battle from nightmare.

faceless-oath.Name: Faceless Oath
faceless-oath.Description: A broken occult vow erases voice and self-image piece by piece.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 4d6 spirit damage and stupefied 1; speaking is blocked, and damage caused by the affliction cannot be healed.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 5d6 spirit damage, stupefied 2, and drained 1; speaking and healing are blocked.

eclipse-scorpion-venom.Name: Eclipse Scorpion Venom
eclipse-scorpion-venom.Description: This venom carries a dark afterimage that poisons the blood while pulling vitality from the body.

memory-maw-infestation.Name: Memory-Maw Infestation
memory-maw-infestation.Description: Invisible parasites chew holes in memory, leaving only the certainty that something important has been forgotten.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 5d6 mental damage, stupefied 2, and drained 1; concentrate actions require a DC 6 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 6d6 mental damage, stupefied 3, drained 1, and confused; concentrate actions require a DC 8 flat check.

crimson-reflection.Name: Crimson Reflection
crimson-reflection.Description: The reflection begins to bleed before the victim is wounded, and every drop carries vitality away.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 5d6 spirit damage and drained 1; damage caused by the affliction cannot be healed.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 6d6 void damage, drained 2, and doomed 1; healing is blocked.

void-moth-dust.Name: Void-Moth Dust
void-moth-dust.Description: Black dust from planar moth wings erases color, sound, and eventually coherent thought.

dream-prison.Name: Dream Prison
dream-prison.Description: The curse builds a closed dream from memories, where every escape route leads back to the beginning.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 6d6 mental damage, stupefied 2, and slowed 1; concentrate actions require a DC 7 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 7d6 mental damage, stupefied 3, and slowed 2; concentrate actions require a DC 9 flat check.

skin-writer-parasite.Name: Skin-Writer Parasite
skin-writer-parasite.Description: The parasite writes itself in moving lines beneath the skin, reshaping the body according to an alien alphabet.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 7d6 void damage, drained 2, clumsy 2, and doomed 1.

unmaking-whisper.Name: Unmaking Whisper
unmaking-whisper.Description: An impossible sentence describes the victim as though they had never existed, and the world begins to listen.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 8d6 mental damage, stupefied 3, and drained 1; concentrate actions require a DC 8 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 10d6 spirit damage, stupefied 3, drained 2, and doomed 1; concentrate actions require a DC 10 flat check.

night-between-stars.Name: The Night Between Stars
night-between-stars.Description: Something from the dark interval between stars hooks into the mind and pulls it away from familiar reality.

Stage1.Name: Stage 1
Stage1.Description: 7d6 void damage, 4d6 mental damage, and frightened 1.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 9d6 void damage, drained 2, and slowed 1; damage caused by the affliction cannot be healed.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 11d6 void damage, drained 3, slowed 2, and doomed 2; healing is blocked.

devouring-dream.Name: The Devouring Dream
devouring-dream.Description: The dream is no longer a place but a predator. With each stage it devours more of the waking person until only the dream remains.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 10d6 mental damage, stupefied 3, and slowed 1; concentrate actions require a DC 9 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: 12d6 mental and 6d6 void damage, drained 3, and doomed 2; concentrate actions require a DC 11 flat check.

Stage4.Name: Stage 4
Stage4.Description: 14d6 mental and 8d6 void damage; death effect.
